newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania cenbank licenses Greek Alpha Credit bank.
newsitem.headline: Albania cenbank licenses Greek Alpha Credit bank.

text.p: Albania's central bank said on Tuesday it had licensed Greece's private Alpha Credit bank to open a branch in Tirana, the third Greek bank to start business in Europe's poorest country.

Athens-based Alpha Credit Bank will have an initial base capital of 200 million leks ($2 million). Its operations will include managing deposits, extending credit and borrowing funds, the central bank said.
Albania has so far issued licences to three foreign banks, two from neighbouring Greece and one Malaysian-owned, in a bid to create a more efficient banking system and draw in foreign capital.
"Alpha Credit is a very powerful bank, the third biggest bank in Greece, and this is very positive for us," the central bank official added.
